org_name: KIDS&Co. (Międzynarodowe Dwujęzyczne Przedszkola i Żłobki KIDS&Co.)
num_settings: 34 (2026, per AcadeMedia acquisition announcement); 35 in 10 cities per own site
ownership: AcadeMedia AB (Sweden) – acquisition announced Aug 2026; founded 2006 by Karina Trafna
background: KIDS&Co. was founded in 2006 by Karina Trafna and is Poland's largest international bilingual preschool chain. It operates 34-35 preschools and nurseries, mostly inside office buildings in Warsaw, Wrocław, Kraków, Poznań, Łódź, Gdańsk, Gdynia and Katowice, often as corporate kindergartens for tenants (e.g. Franklin Templeton, Quattro Business Park). 2025 net revenue was about PLN 99 million with c. 3,000 childcare places. In August 2026 Swedish listed education group AcadeMedia announced the acquisition of the chain – its first entry into Poland. The group planned to open its first primary school in Warsaw in September 2026. Lead scoring is high because it is the largest, best-capitalised operator and is now part of a group that centralises procurement.
notes: Post-acquisition, AcadeMedia group (Stockholm) may own procurement decisions; check for a new country manager.

org_name: Happy Kids (Przedszkola i Żłobki Happy Kids, Kraków)
num_settings: 9 (6 public, 2 private preschools + 1 nursery) per own site (2025/26)
hq_address: Kraków (ul. Armii Krajowej 12 corporate kindergarten; other sites incl. ul. Lema, ul. Piltza, ul. Halszki)
background: Happy Kids is a Kraków network of language preschools founded in 2011 (operations from January 2012) by Dagmara Osman. It runs six public (municipally-funded) preschools, two private preschools and a nursery, with sports-language and arts-language profiles. It has a corporate-kindergarten line: since 2013 it has operated an IBM staff kindergarten near IBM's Kraków office. The network positions itself on holistic development and healthy lifestyle. It is a mid-sized, owner-managed operator with a single decision maker.
notes: Not to be confused with Fundacja Happy Kids (Łódź, foster-care homes) or Happy Kids Osowa (Gdańsk, independent).

background: Pod Magnolią is a Silesian network of English-immersion preschools founded in 2008 in Katowice. It operates ten sites – eight company-owned and two franchised – and actively recruits franchisees across Poland (entry fee c. PLN 50k, monthly fee from PLN 5k). Daily English is taught by qualified teachers. Some sites operate as publicly-funded (publiczne) preschools. Owner Justyna Pacuła is the named decision maker in franchise press coverage.
notes: KRS listing names 'Justyna Kudła' as the decision-maker – may be the same person under a different surname; verify.

background: Zielona Wieża is a Polish network of attachment-parenting ('bliskościowe') preschools and nurseries combining forest pedagogy, NVC and Montessori elements. Founded in January 2014, it now runs six sites in Warsaw, Kraków, Wieliczka and Lublin and offers a franchise-style model that keeps each site autonomous. The Lublin site was founded by Diana Ciszewska (physics/philosophy/pedagogy). Decision-making is decentralised, so each site director is also a buyer.
notes: Central owner of the brand not confirmed; Diana Ciszewska confirmed only for Lublin site.
